Conditions, commands and validation scope Assumptions γ=1.4, initial jump x=−4, left (ρ,u,p)=(3.857143,2.629369,10.33333), and right ρ=1+0.2sin(5x), u=0, p=1. The initial jump aligns with a face on every grid. Pointwise FD, global LF splitting, face-frozen Roe characteristics, WENO-Z exponent 2, ε=10^-6, SSPRK3 and CFL=0.3 are used. Use these commands in the working directory specified by the execution guide after extracting the ZIP. A command may execute several cases in the package. python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python run_recipe.py --input recipes/shu-osher.json --output output-shu-osher python -m pytest -q tests/test_recipes.py Validation limits The 800-point solution is a same-method numerical reference, not an exact solution or independent solver. The mean-density difference bound of 0.15 is an educational structure-resolution criterion, not a high-accuracy certification. Only decreasing discrepancy under grid doubling is tested; no formal order is assigned. Positive outputs and counted rejections do not establish positivity for every input.
